guide.title: Getting Started
guide.content: Drop audio or video files onto the drop zone, or click the drop area to browse your files. Files are added to the queue ready for processing. Select pending files and click Enhance All to remove background noise using DeepFilterNet3 — adjust Enhancement Strength in General settings. Select a processed file to open the waveform player with A/B toggle to compare original and enhanced audio. Click the microphone icon to record directly from your input device.

sections.gettingStartedContent: Drop audio or video files onto the drop zone. Files are added to the queue. Click a row to select it.
sections.enhanceContent: Select pending files and click Enhance All to remove background noise using DeepFilterNet3 (AI). Adjust Enhancement Strength in Settings.
sections.convertContent: Choose an output format per file (or apply globally) then click Convert All. Supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, OPUS, M4A.
sections.waveformContent: Select a processed file to see its waveform. Use A/B toggle to compare original vs enhanced audio. Adjust gain and zoom with the controls below the waveform.
sections.keyboardContent: Ctrl+A: Select all | Escape: Deselect | Delete: Remove selected | E: Enhance All | C: Convert All
